entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Merfolk wizard and former Prime Speaker of the Simic Combine, murdered at Karlov Manor.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Ravnican guild led by a Prime Speaker.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: Replaced Zegana as guildmaster of the Simic.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: Dimir assassin who killed Zegana under mind control.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Selesnya dryad whose central dryad Oba cultivated the mind-control plant.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Central dryad of Trostani who mistakenly targeted Zegana.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Former Simic leader whose fall preceded the Fathom Edict.

entities.name: Fathom Edict
entities.description: Edict declaring a new beginning for the Simic.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: Detective who deduced Etrata killed Zegana.

entities.name: Karlov Manor
entities.description: Site of the celebration where Zegana was killed.

entities.name: Adaptationists
entities.description: Simic faction that argued for practical leadership.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Zegana experimented with Phyrexian oil.

events.summary: As Prime Speaker, Zegana delivers the Fathom Edict declaring a new beginning after Momir Vig's fall.
Adaptationists argue her ways are outdated and Zegana is replaced by Vannifar, accepting the judgment.
Zegana retires to Zonot One and advocates for the Utopians.
events.quote: a vocal advocate for the Utopian movement

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Zegana and Vannifar settle grievances and Zegana experiments with Phyrexian oil, later failing to regain the Prime Speakership.
events.quote: Vannifar and Zegana settled their old grievances

events.summary: Zegana is assassinated at a celebration at Karlov Manor; Alquist Proft deduces Etrata, mind-controlled by a plant of Oba, was the killer.
events.quote: Zegana was assassinated during a celebration at Karlov Manor

relations.quote: Zegana had been killed by the Dimir assassin
